Offline text reader used by the Bill page (bill.html).
 - tesseract.min.js, worker.min.js     : tesseract.js 5.1.1 (Apache-2.0)
 - tesseract-core-*-lstm.wasm.js       : tesseract.js-core 5.1.1 (Apache-2.0)
 - lang/eng.traineddata.gz             : English model, tessdata_best_int (Apache-2.0)
Served from this folder so the Bill page works without internet access.
